decisions.reason: As a newly launched product line close to the firm's craft-based core offer and prominently shown on the home page, it is likely to be retained while management justifies its recent investment.
This product fits the established Christmas pyramid business and was publicly promoted, so a traditional German craft firm with no clear sign of failure would be inclined to give it more time.

Because it was presented as a flagship direction, offered in several models, and publicly highlighted, escalation of commitment makes management especially likely to persist despite its more distant fit.
Although less visible and farther from the traditional range, it supports the flagship electronic music box and is therefore likely to be kept at least another year.

This accessory is relatively easy to trim, but since it complements the publicly emphasized music-box platform and the launch is still recent, management would more likely continue than withdraw it immediately.
Built on the firm's established seasonal handcrafted offer and promoted on the home page, it has strong strategic fit and little reason to be removed so soon after launch.
